dataset._manifest_location_note: the manifest stays under /apex-data on purpose: this decision commits to its sha256, so a swapped manifest is refused by content and its location needs no trust

scope._scope_note: train 2016-2019 and validation 2020-2021 ONLY. Evaluation 2022-2024 and reserve 2025+ are NOT in this proposal; unsealing evaluation is a separate decision with its own temporal_range and its own command.

availability.restricted_use: HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_ONLY: no publication or revision record exists for these bars; they may not be used to claim point-in-time availability or to model vendor revisions; receipt was bulk on 2026-08-29, so no row is evidence of what was knowable before that date except by its event time; availability is ASSUMED at bar completion (event_time + 60 s) and every forecast records availability_basis = ASSUMED_BAR_CLOSE; the exchange calendar for this window is reconciled date by date against the primary NYSE Group announcements (results/exp001b_calendar_reconciliation_2016_2021.json), and the loader refuses any date outside that window

purpose.research_purpose: ALPHA-EXP-001B train and validation stages on real SPY 1-minute bars, NYSE regular session per the independently reconciled 2016-2021 exchange calendar, distributional validation only; evaluation remains sealed; no economic stage
